Delivery

White-label delivery

Your delivery partner. We deliver under your name.

Get a quote 514-424-7936

The service in detail

Your customers know your brand, not your carrier’s. With white-label delivery, Groupe Gama becomes your delivery service: our drivers introduce themselves on behalf of your business, follow your delivery instructions and bring back signatures and returns. You offer local delivery without buying a truck or hiring a driver.

What’s included

  • Drivers who represent your business
  • Last-mile delivery for online stores, retailers and distributors
  • Fixed or on-demand routes, same day or next day
  • Returns and exchanges handled
  • Furniture and appliance delivery with basic installation on request
  • Simple monthly billing

How it works

  1. Let’s define your service

    Zones, delivery times promised to your customers, drop-off instructions, weekly volume.

  2. We integrate your orders

    Sent by email, file or platform: we plan the routes.

  3. Your customers get their orders

    From a Gama driver representing your brand, with confirmation of every delivery.

FAQ

FAQ — white-label delivery

What is white-label delivery?

It is a service where the carrier delivers on behalf of the merchant: the end customer only sees your brand. We handle the logistics; you keep the customer relationship.

What is the minimum volume?

There is no strict minimum. Fixed routes pay off from a few deliveries a day; below that, the on-demand service is a better fit.

Do you deliver large items (furniture, appliances)?

Yes, with two people and protective equipment. Basic installation (placement, simple hook-up) can be added.

How are returns handled?

The driver picks up the item according to your instructions and brings it back to your warehouse or store during the route.
